text: default_mode=always paper unless owner says live
confirm_pair_before_order=always confirm the pair with the owner before any order
Before any order, confirm the pair and amount with the owner; default to paper unless they explicitly say live.
Spread read: trust ONLY the 15m timeframe. Other timeframes (5m/60m/240m/1440m) are noise or too slow for the spread signal.
Shared signals: BOTH the MA spread AND the MA20/MA50 cross come from the 15m timeframe only. Other intervals use their own range/trend/structure, but spread and MA-cross are 15m-trusted.
